description: This PHP source file defines the LeaveStatusChangeEmailProcessor class, which handles email processing related to leave status changes within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for generating email replacements, determining recipients based on roles, and verifying leave data consistency.

classes.name: LeaveStatusChangeEmailProcessor
classes.description: A class responsible for processing email content related to leave status changes, including generating email replacements, determining recipients, and validating leave data, within the OrangeHRM HRM system.

methods.name: getReplacements
methods.description: Generates a set of string replacements for the email template based on the leave status change event, including performer, applicant, leave details, and comments.

methods.name: getRecipients
methods.description: Determines the list of email recipients based on the role (subscriber, supervisor, ess, etc.) and the leave change event.

methods.name: verifyLeavesFromOneLeaveRequest
methods.description: Validates that the provided array of leaves all belong to the same leave request, throwing an exception if not.
